summary: Full frontend regression of the 15 client fixes on https://galista-atelier.preview.emergentagent.com/. Tested FR (desktop 1920), FR mobile (390x844), DE and EN locales. All 15 fixes verified green: reviews carousel with real quotes + counter + autoplay toggle, solid sticky tab background in #carte, mobile single-line scrollable tabs, Made-with-Emergent masking script present in index.html, Instagram embed auto-loads via IntersectionObserver (iframe present, load button removed), INGRÉDIENTS label removed from #carte, allergens note moved to bottom with correct text and no old 'non affichés' mention, hero shows photo (no IMAGE D'ILLUSTRATION badge), flat MapLibre canvas (no spin toggle), mobile-action-bar pinned to bottom, SEO head is complete (canonical FR, 4 hreflang, og:image absolute 1200x630, twitter summary_large_image, JSON-LD CafeOrCoffeeShop with aggregateRating 4.8/275 and 2 OpeningHoursSpecification, noscript h1), robots.txt text/plain with Sitemap directive, sitemap.xml application/xml with 3 URLs, og-image.jpg 200 image/jpeg. DE and EN translations load correctly without raw i18n keys.
console_notes: Pre-existing MapLibre worker warning and permissions-policy 'bluetooth' warning are environmental (preview container) and expected per request context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 client fixes validated. Use sessionStorage.setItem('galista-loader-seen','1') + reload to bypass the loader. Review carousel testid is dynamic — use selector [data-testid^=review-quote-]. MapLibre lazy-loads on scroll to #infos; wait ~3s. Instagram iframe loads via IntersectionObserver after scroll to #galerie; allow ~8s.
